prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create an ORIGINAL little male fairy knight character for this project's children's fantasy character collection. This is a new character, not a costume version of a pre-existing franchise knight. Use the attached existing project character ONLY as the visual basis for large expressive eyes, oversized head/small separate torso and limbs, glossy soft toy-like 3D rendering and delicate fantasy detailing. Do not copy that character's face, hair, crown, costume, emblems or identity: the user requests a new design.
Design: friendly youthful male woodland guardian, rounded warm ivory face fully uncovered, huge expressive TEAL eyes with visible whites and pupils, rosy cheeks, small cheerful smile, soft short chestnut curls with a little side curl. Small open-faced brushed COPPER helmet shaped like a smooth acorn cup, a single rounded mint leaf ornament at the side, no horns, no plume, no visor and no mask. Separate pear-shaped torso and short clearly visible arms and legs. Cream padded tunic under scalloped copper and sage-green chest armour, a simple original three-leaf sprout emblem on chest, mint trim, rounded copper wrist cuffs and cream boots with copper toe caps. Short soft FOREST GREEN cape with pale mint lining, leaf-scalloped hem, fastened with two tiny wooden buttons. Compact oval wooden shield with copper rim and a mint sprout emblem, carried at one side. Other hand holds a SHORT simple rounded training sword pointing downward, pale pearly blade with round tip, plain copper crossguard and wooden handle, no barbs, elaborate gold shape or red jewels. Peaceful relaxed standing pose, slightly turned, fully visible from helmet to shoes, not attacking.
Create a distinct upright biped silhouette, not a round masked ball. No silver faceplate, black face slit, glowing yellow eyes, blue or purple body, navy cloak, bat wings, long white crest, letter monogram, franchise symbols, jagged golden sword or recognizable existing character design. Copper/sage/cream palette and sprout motif throughout. Refined polished children's fantasy 3D character artwork, subtly textured fabric and warm metallic highlights. Transparent background, no scenery, no text or watermark, generous padding, portrait aspect ratio.
design: New woodland knight using generic cape, armour and shield archetypes; copper, sage, ivory, visible face, sprout motif. No legal clearance claimed.
